summary: Prompt 9 ANPR result-card frontend testing. Mobile web (430x932) + Webdash (1920x800) both verified against the two production incident IDs. Backend spot-check via curl: GET /api/incidents/668d75cc... returns plate_status=detected, plate_source=rekognition, plate_confidence=64.17, detected_plate=MH02FX2660 (matches spec). Not_detected incident 8b79a503... returns plate_status=not_detected, plate_reason=no_valid_plate. Mobile: language screen -> phone +918483029039 -> OTP 123456 (single successful attempt), deep-link to detected & not_detected screens both render exactly as specified; incident-plate-text=MH02FX2660, Confidence 64%, Copy button triggers 'Copied' toast, both incident-object-location and incident-device-location blocks show '301, Building, 15th Road, Khar West, Konkan Division' + coords 19.07547, 72.83192, incident-captured-at row shows '16/07/2026 03:31 PM'. Not_detected: incident-plate-missing banner 'Number Plate Not Detected' + reason 'Text found but not a valid plate', no plate-card. Webdash: password login (0001/Hogo@2026Cgm) OK; /dept/ACCOUNTS shows detected incident with inline '🚗 MH02FX2660' chip in feed and clicking opens modal with modal-plate-text=MH02FX2660, Confidence: 64%, modal-object-location + modal-device-location (same address+coords), captured-at line, media with 'submitted' status badge. Trends chart (14-day) and attendance register render without errors. Not_detected incident 8b79a503... is in dept CANE_YARD (NOT ACCOUNTS as review request stated); tested there — modal-plate-missing shows '🚫 Number Plate Not Detected' + reason, both location blocks + captured-at present. Copy button in webdash modal did NOT visually flip to 'Copied' state under Playwright (clipboard API present but writeText likely rejected without explicit clipboard-write permission grant in test env) — mobile toast worked because it does not depend on clipboard resolution the same way (mobile calls showToast synchronously after await Clipboard.setStringAsync which resolves). Recommend adding a .catch fallback so users still see 'Copied' feedback if clipboard rejects.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText(...).then(setCopied) has no .catch(); if clipboard API rejects (e.g., permissions/insecure context) the '✓ Copied' state never toggles and user gets no feedback. Reference: /app/webdash/src/screens/Department.tsx:21-25

action_items: Optional: harden modal-plate-copy in webdash by adding .catch() and using document.execCommand fallback so 'Copied' toast fires even when navigator.clipboard rejects.
Minor doc nit: review request stated not_detected incident 8b79a503... is in ACCOUNTS feed — it is actually in CANE_YARD (department_code=CANE_YARD). Tests passed there. No code change needed.
Nothing else required — all Prompt 9 acceptance criteria verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Clipboard write path in both files should have a rejection fallback: /app/webdash/src/screens/Department.tsx:21 (no .catch) and /app/frontend/app/incident/[id].tsx:140 (uses expo-clipboard so it awaits, but a try/catch would prevent an uncaught promise rejection if writing fails).
